r.s: ABOUT YANKEE RP
YANKEE SCHOOL RP
HOME
Welcome to Yankee School RP, where school life gets rough.
Yankee School RP is a FiveM roleplay server centered around Japanese-inspired school life, delinquent culture, street rivalries, and character-driven stories.
Step into a world where your reputation matters, friendships can become alliances, and every decision can shape your place in the school and the streets.

Inspired by the atmosphere of Tokyo Revengers, WIND BREAKER, and HIGH&LOW, Yankee School RP combines school-life roleplay with the intensity of delinquent crews, rival schools, underground hangouts, and street conflicts.
🎒 Your School. Your Crew. Your Story.
Start as an ordinary student and build your own reputation. Make friends, find rivals, join or create a crew, represent your school, and carve out your own path.
Whether you want to be a
troublemaker, respected fighter, loyal friend, student leader, teacher, gang member, or simply someone trying to survive school life
, there's a place for you.
🔥 What You Can Expect
🏫 Immersive school-focused roleplay
🥊 Delinquent crews and rival factions
⚔️ School rivalries and territory conflicts
👊 Character-driven fights and rivalries
🤝 Friendships, alliances, betrayals, and drama
🛵 Street culture and late-night hangouts
🎭 Serious and casual RP opportunities
📖 Player-created stories and long-term character development
🌃 A Japanese-inspired urban atmosphere
🏆 Reputation, respect, and crew progression
🩸 Rise Through the Ranks
In Yankee School RP, respect isn't given, it's earned.
Build your name through your actions. Stand up for your friends, represent your crew, challenge your rivals, or stay out of trouble and focus on school. The choices you make create the story.
Will you become the strongest student in school?
The leader of the streets?
A legend remembered by everyone?
Or will you simply become another name lost in the halls?
Your story starts here.

HOME
1. No Return After Death
Once you are killed during a school raid and respawn or use STL, you are not allowed to return to the same school that you were killed at.
Attackers may only participate again on the next school they plan to raid.
Defenders who are killed are also not allowed to return to their school to continue defending during the same raid.
Dead players must wait until the next raid/run to participate again.
2. Multiple School Raids
If a school raid is still ongoing, other schools may also be attacked.
Players are allowed to participate in another raid as long as they follow all raid rules.
No School Alliances During Raids
Schools are strictly prohibited from teaming up or forming alliances with other schools to raid a single school.
Multiple schools may raid the same school during an event, but each school must operate independently and cannot cooperate with another school.
Any form of coordination, mutual assistance, or collaboration between different schools to attack a target school is strictly prohibited.
3. Vault Loot & Defender Pursuit
Once the attacking school successfully obtains the vault loot, defenders may continue defending the school grounds.
However, once the looters have left the school grounds, defenders are not allowed to chase or pursue them outside the school premises.
The raid is considered complete for the defenders once the looters have successfully left the school grounds with the vault loot.
4. Enforcement
All players are expected to follow these rules to ensure fair and enjoyable school RP.
Returning to a school after being killed, respawning, or using STL is prohibited.
Staff/Admins may issue sanctions to players who intentionally violate these rules.
Claiming ignorance of the rules will not excuse a violation.
Failure to follow these rules may result in warnings, punishments, or other sanctions determined by staff.

DISCLAIMER: These rules are not final and are subject to change at any time at the discretion of the server administration. Players are responsible for staying updated on any revisions or announcements regarding the rules.

GENERAL RULES
COMMUNICATION & PLAYER CONDUCT RULES
1. IN-GAME COMMUNICATION ONLY
All communication pertaining to in-game activities, roleplay, or interactions MUST be conducted through the game.
The use of third-party applications or external communication platforms to coordinate, communicate, or exchange information related to in-game activities is strictly prohibited.
Violations of this rule may result in disciplinary action, up to and including removal from the server.
2. MICROPHONE REQUIREMENT
A fully operational microphone is mandatory for all players at all times while participating in-game.
Players are required to test their microphone before logging into the server. Claiming that a microphone is malfunctioning after entering the server will not excuse a violation of this requirement.
Players who cannot maintain functional voice communication may be subject to removal from the server or further disciplinary action.
3. VOICE CHANGER POLICY
Voice changers may only be used when portraying a character for whom an altered voice is reasonably appropriate.
The altered voice MUST remain clear, understandable, and suitable for roleplay.

Before using a voice changer, players are REQUIRED to submit a ticket and provide a recording for Staff review. Failure to obtain approval before use may result in disciplinary action. Staff reserve the right to prohibit any voice changer that interferes with communication, negatively impacts roleplay, or is deemed inappropriate.
4. ZERO TOLERANCE — RACISM & DISCRIMINATION
Racism, racial slurs, hate speech, and discriminatory behavior are strictly prohibited.

This rule applies regardless of whether the behavior is claimed to be "in character," a joke, or part of roleplay. Using roleplay as an excuse for racist or discriminatory conduct will not be accepted.
Choose your words carefully. Players are expected to maintain a respectful environment at all times.
Violations will result in immediate disciplinary action, with penalties determined by Staff based on the severity and circumstances of the offense.

PLAYER VOUCHING
HOME
Any player who vouches for a whitelist applicant will be held accountable for the player they have vouched for.
By vouching for an applicant, the voucher confirms that they personally know and trust the applicant and are willing to take responsibility for their conduct within the server.
The tagged/vouching player may be held liable if the player they vouched for violates any server rules.
If a vouched player is found to have violated server rules, the player who provided the vouch may also receive a sanction.
The appropriate sanction will be determined by the Administration/Server Committee, based on the severity and circumstances of the violation.
Vouching for a player should therefore be taken seriously. Players are expected to vouch only for individuals they trust to follow the server's rules and community standards.
Claiming that the voucher was unaware of the vouched player's actions does not automatically exempt them from potential sanctions.
In short: If you vouch for someone, you are putting your name and standing in the community behind that player. Vouch responsibly.

IN-GAME RULES
1. CHARACTER NAME REQUIREMENT
All characters MUST use a realistic and appropriate full name that is suitable for a serious roleplay environment.
The use of nicknames, meme names, celebrity names, public-figure names, joke names, offensive names, or intentionally unrealistic names is strictly prohibited.
If you are uncertain whether your desired character name is acceptable, FILE A TICKET BEFORE CREATING OR USING THE CHARACTER and wait for Staff approval.
Ignorance of this rule will not be accepted as an excuse.
2. VOICE RECOGNITION
Voice recognition is strictly prohibited when there is no reasonable in-character basis for identifying another player. You MUST act as though you do not know or recognize the individual.
Using out-of-character knowledge to identify a character is considered a violation of In Character integrity.
3. STAY IN CHARACTER
Players are required to remain in character at all times while in-game.

If an issue, bug, disagreement, or other problem occurs during an active scenario, players MUST continue roleplaying the situation and address the issue afterward through the appropriate Staff Support Ticket.
Breaking character to resolve an issue is not permitted unless Staff intervention is required.
4. COMBAT LOGGING
Players MUST NOT quit, disconnect, exit the game, or intentionally evade an active scenario while an interaction, pursuit, combat situation, or other roleplay scenario is ongoing.
If you disconnect unintentionally, you are expected to return as soon as reasonably possible and continue the scenario.
Attempting to avoid consequences by leaving the server will result in disciplinary action.
HOME
5. NO CROSS-RP
Cross-RP is strictly prohibited.
Information, events, relationships, conflicts, or knowledge obtained from another city/server MUST NOT be carried over.  What happens in another city stays in that city.
6. NO CUT RP
There is NO "cut RP" unless all parties involved mutually agree to end the scenario with Staff assistance through a Support Ticket.
Players may not unilaterally declare a scenario finished, cancel an interaction, or disregard an ongoing roleplay situation simply because they no longer wish to participate.
If a scenario requires intervention or cannot reasonably continue, FILE A SUPPORT TICKET and allow Staff to assist.
7. FEATHER HANDLE / POSTS / PHOTOS
All Feather Handle posts, character posts, and in-game photos MUST remain In Character and relevant to the roleplay environment.
OOC-related content, references, conversations, or information MUST NOT be used or posted through IC channels.
Players are expected to maintain a clear separation between In Character and OOC interactions.
8. KNOW YOUR LIMITS
Know when to stop.
Players are expected to recognize when a situation has reached its reasonable limit and avoid unnecessarily escalating or prolonging a scenario.

Roleplay is intended to create an enjoyable experience for everyone involved. Do not force situations, repeatedly provoke other players, or continue an interaction solely to cause frustration or disruption.

If Staff determines that a player is intentionally taking a scenario beyond reasonable limits, disciplinary action may be issued. When in doubt, de-escalate, continue appropriate roleplay, and contact Staff through a Support Ticket.
HOME
9. METAGAMING
Metagaming is STRICTLY PROHIBITED.
Metagaming is the use of any information that your character did not obtain through legitimate in-game or roleplay interactions to influence your character's actions, decisions, or knowledge.
Your character MUST ONLY act upon information they could reasonably know through their own in-character experiences.
10. STREAM SNIPING / STREAM LURKING
11. POWERGAMING
Powergaming is STRICTLY PROHIBITED.

Powergaming is the act of roleplaying actions, abilities, or outcomes that are outside your character's established traits, capabilities, or current circumstances, or abusing game mechanics to gain an unfair advantage over other players.

Players MUST roleplay within the reasonable physical and character limitations of their character. You may not force actions, outcomes, or advantages that would not realistically be possible within the current scenario.
Players MUST NOT exploit, manipulate, or abuse game mechanics to escape, avoid, or gain an advantage.
Players are STRICTLY PROHIBITED from watching or monitoring streams while actively participating in the city when the purpose or effect is to obtain information about ongoing roleplay.
Using a stream to locate players, identify their activities, or gain knowledge that your character would not otherwise possess will be treated as Metagaming.

Attempting to gain an advantage through Metagaming, whether directly or indirectly, will result in disciplinary action. Staff may determine the appropriate punishment based on the severity and impact of the violation.
12. RANDOM DEATHMATCH (RDM)
Random Deathmatch (RDM) is STRICTLY PROHIBITED.
RDM is the act of attacking, assaulting, or killing another player or group without sufficient roleplay, interaction, or valid in-character justification leading up to the incident.
Players MUST establish legitimate RP before initiating violence against another player or group.
HOME
13. VALUE YOUR LIFE/NO VALUE OF LIFE
Your character's life MUST be treated as valuable at all times. Players are expected to make reasonable and believable attempts to preserve their character's life when faced with danger.
Fists, blunt weapons, bladed weapons, and tasers are exceptions.
Players may defend themselves or attempt to retaliate when reasonably possible.
You may defend yourself or attempt to escape ONLY when a realistic opportunity to do so exists.
POST-KILL INTERACTIONS
Players are STRICTLY PROHIBITED from trash-talking, taunting, mocking, or disrespecting players who are downed or dead.
Being downed or killed does NOT give you permission to verbally harass, humiliate, provoke, or disrespect the other player.
Maintain proper roleplay and respect at all times, regardless of the outcome of the encounter.
RP BEFORE VIOLENCE
The first response to any disagreement should always be roleplay and de-escalation.
Players MUST NOT immediately resort to physical violence simply because of a disagreement, insult, argument, or minor conflict.
Before initiating violence, players are expected to provide:
A legitimate In-Character reason.
Appropriate roleplay and escalation.
Clear warnings or demands when reasonably possible.
A reasonable opportunity for the other party to comply, leave, or de-escalate.
No Value of Life (NVL), Fail Fear RP, is STRICTLY PROHIBITED.

Players MUST realistically fear for their character's life when threatened, serious injury, overwhelming force, or other circumstances that would reasonably place their character in danger. Your character is expected to react in a manner consistent with the level of danger presented.
HOME
16. FORCED ROLEPLAY
Players may not force themselves into an ongoing scenario simply because they want to participate.
Repeatedly inserting yourself into scenarios, ignoring requests to leave, or deliberately escalating situations may result in disciplinary action.
Do not repeatedly force players into respawn situations simply because it is convenient.
Likewise, do not manipulate NLR mechanics to erase inconvenient information or avoid legitimate future roleplay.
NLR IS A ROLEPLAY RULE. NOT A TOOL TO RESET CONSEQUENCES WHENEVER IT IS CONVENIENT.
ACTIVE SCENARIOS
You are NOT permitted to respawn while an active scenario is still ongoing.
If the scenario has not concluded, remain involved as appropriate and follow the established RP until the situation is resolved.
NEW LIFE RULE (NLR)
The New Life Ru
le (NLR) applies when your character is forced to respawn following death.
Once you respawn, your character MUST completely forget the circumstances surrounding their death.
This includes, but is not limited to:
Who killed your character.
Why your character was killed.
Where your character was killed.
Events directly leading up to your death.
Information learned during the scenario that led to your death.
Once you have respawned, you MUST NOT return to or interfere with the previous scenario.
